title: Minimum Time to Visit All Houses
summary: Houses form a cycle. From house i, going forward to (i+1) modulo n costs forward[i]; going backward to (i-1) modulo n costs backward[i]. Start at house zero and visit the query houses in order. Return the smallest total travel time.
